changes.comment: On Linux, observe watched projects with one non-recursive watch per directory created by an asynchronous walk instead of Node's recursive fs.watch emulation (one inotify watch per file, synchronous tree walk). Skip node_modules, .git, .rush/temp and declared output folders, follow directories created or removed later, tolerate directories that vanish during registration, and report inotify watch-limit exhaustion (ENOSPC) explicitly.
